# marcusmth.com

> Personal website of Marcus Smith — software engineer (Meta AI, Tech Lead),
> YouTube creator (People Watching walking videos), Delta LAX<->SFO super-commuter.
> Blog posts are practical, data-driven guides: software engineering, YouTube
> content creation, travel/commuting, and personal finance.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://www.marcusmth.com/) - latest blog posts
- [About](https://www.marcusmth.com/about) - about Marcus Smith
- [Reading list](https://www.marcusmth.com/reading) - book recommendations for software engineers
- [Cheatsheets](https://www.marcusmth.com/cheatsheet) - developer quick references
- [RSS feed](https://www.marcusmth.com/api/feed) - all posts as RSS
- [Sitemap](https://www.marcusmth.com/sitemap.xml) - full URL list
